security_audit.summary: Most Markdown backtick and install-path findings are false positives. Three script command references are confirmed because they direct agents to run relative Python scripts with user-supplied paths. No prompt injection evidence found, but provider configuration may be persisted in report artifacts.

remediation.issue: Relative Python script commands in the skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: Use bundled script paths or require explicit user confirmation before running validation commands. Validate report paths before execution.

remediation.issue: Provider configuration can be written to report artifacts
remediation.suggestion: Redact API keys and tokens from run_manifest.json. Store only provider names and nonsecret settings.

content.value_statement: Complex research can lose source context, assumptions, and claim support. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured evidence collection and report assembly.
actual_capabilities: Guides quick, standard, deep, and ultradeep research modes.
Defines a phased workflow from scope and planning through retrieval, synthesis, critique, and packaging.
Requires cited findings, a complete bibliography, and explicit limitations.
Specifies evidence files for sources, quotes, claims, and run metadata.
Lists optional validation commands for report structure, citations, and HTML conversion.
limitations: Best suited for complex research, not simple lookups or debugging.
Requires available search tools or web access for current source collection.
Referenced helper scripts and templates may need separate packaging or setup.
Outputs may contain sensitive research context if users provide confidential topics.

use_cases.title: Technology Evaluation
use_cases.description: Compare platforms, methods, or vendors with cited evidence and decision-focused recommendations.

use_cases.title: Scientific Literature Review
use_cases.description: Map recent findings, source quality, and unresolved questions for a technical topic.

use_cases.title: Market Landscape Report
use_cases.description: Synthesize trends, competitors, adoption signals, and risks into a structured report.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deep research mode to explain [topic] for [audience]. Include current sources, key findings, limitations, and a bibliography.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a structured overview.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] for [decision context]. Use cited evidence, tradeoffs, risks, and a recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a decision report.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Recent Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Research trends in [field] from the last [time period]. Separate confirmed evidence, emerging signals, and uncertain claims.

prompt_templates.title: Run an Ultradeep Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run ultradeep research on [complex question]. Build an evidence ledger, challenge assumptions, verify major claims, and produce a final report.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for rigorous synthesis and critique.

output_examples.input: Deep research the current state of quantum computing for enterprise planning.
output_examples.output: A cited report with an executive summary, major findings, limitations, recommendations, and a full bibliography.

output_examples.input: Compare PostgreSQL and Supabase for our application stack.
output: Decision-focused comparison across architecture, operations, security, cost, and team fit.
Clear recommendation with assumptions and cited support.

output_examples.input: Analyze recent biotech AI platform trends for a product strategy review.
output_examples.output: A market landscape report that separates mature evidence, emerging signals, and open questions.

best_practices: State the audience, decision context, and time horizon before starting.
Ask for citations and limitations to remain visible in the final report.
Review generated evidence files for confidential data before sharing outputs.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for one-answer lookups that need only a quick search.
Accepting uncited claims in the final report.
Storing provider keys or confidential source material in report artifacts.

faq.question: Does this replace a search engine?
faq.answer: No. It organizes multi-source research and uses available search tools to gather evidence.

faq.question: Can it produce HTML or PDF?
faq.answer: The skill describes HTML and PDF packaging, but local tool setup may be required.

faq.question: Does it need API keys?
faq.answer: Basic use may work without extra keys. Multi-provider search needs configured provider keys.

faq.question: Can it verify citations?
faq.answer: It defines citation checks and optional validation commands. Users should still review important citations.

faq.question: Where are outputs stored?
faq.answer: The skill directs outputs to a research folder under Documents and uses evidence ledgers.

faq.question: Is it suitable for confidential research?
faq.answer: Use caution. Review generated files and redact secrets before sharing or syncing outputs.
